verdict.rationale: Missive has AI rules of its own (docs-62), and its changelog describes letting an agent triage new conversations before you look at them (docs-22). Standard rules can apply labels (docs-58), the session tab shows what the assistant is doing (docs-34), and every action is logged (docs-9), which gives some steering and audit. The triage example, though, comes from external AI apps connecting over MCP, and the native AI rules appear in only one passing mention. Missing for 10: documentation of native AI auto-labeling and categorization, AI surfacing or prioritizing what needs attention, explicit steering controls for AI triage behavior, an audit trail specific to AI triage decisions, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit

citations.quote: Your AI rules, saved models, and assistant conversations stay intact
Let an agent triage new conversations against your CRM before you look at them
The session tab now shows what the assistant is up to
Every action within Missive is logged, so you know who did what, and when.
